text:
Are you still drinking the same amount of caffeine as you did before you quit?
Vaping nicotine accelerates the metabolism of caffeine. The nicotine from the vape induces specific enzymes in your liver, CYP1A2, which break down caffeine 50% faster than normal. This increased clearance means caffeine effects wear off more quickly, When you quit vaping, it's like doubling the amount of caffeine you ingest even though you're consuming the same amount. If so, try cutting back a bit (or a lot).
I actually found I had better, more restorative sleep after I quit vaping, right from the start, but everybody's different.
